items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: There was a guy called Louie Panico, I thought he was -- he did a little something with a wa-wa mute, I liked that, but it proved to be nothing after listening to some jazz, man, what he was doing was nothing.

ctx.x: I see, but you weren't really listening to any of the white ones, the white players?

No, because I didn't hear anyone that I liked, at that time. There was a guy called Louie Panico, I thought he was -- he did a little something with a wa-wa mute, I liked that, but it proved to be nothing after listening to some jazz, man, what he was doing was nothing.
But, at that time, I was -- to hear a trumpet make cat calls, all over the wa-wa mute, it excited everybody.
